LQSAT is a Chinese satellite designed to collect high-resolution imagery, high-definition video and test new Earth observing technologies. The satellite is about the size of a compact car, and it reportedly has a top resolution of about 0.7 meters, or 2.3 feet, in its black and white imaging mode.
